accumulate: Ordered mapping, empty inputs, generic element types and different output types.
affine-cipher: Coprime-key validation, modular inverse, alphabet rotation, digits, punctuation filtering and five-character groups.
alphametics: Distinct digits, leading-zero prohibition, repeated letters, multi-column carries and unsatisfiable equations.
bank-account: Open/close/reopen, invalid and zero amounts, funds checks, overflow without mutation and atomic concurrent transactions/lifecycle.
beer-song: 99-to-zero verses, singular/plural, store restart and blank-line separation.
binary: Manual positional conversion, invalid digits, zero/empty input and fixed-width overflow errors.
book-store: All group discounts, repeated volumes, global optimal grouping rather than greedy grouping, and prices in cents.
bottle-song: Ten-to-zero words, singular/plural, requested verse count and blank-line separation.
bowling: Ten frames, strike/spare bonuses, tenth-frame bonus rules, invalid rolls, incomplete scores and post-game rejection.
camicia: Payment-card interruptions, deck/pile order, exhaustion, trick counts and exact loop states including player turn.
change: Minimum coin count rather than greedy selection, sorted results, zero target and unreachable/negative targets.
connect: Whitespace-normalized hex boards, six neighbors, X west/east, O north/south and no winner.
custom-set: Duplicate elimination, membership/add, subset/disjoint/equality, union/intersection/difference and empty sets.
diffie-hellman: Private-key range/randomness, public/shared modular exponentiation and products that do not overflow before reduction.
dominoes: Every tile exactly once, both orientations, closed endpoints, empty chains and disconnected/impossible chains.
dot-dsl: Nodes/edges/attributes, graph attribute replacement, malformed arities and unknown item kinds.
flatten-array: Arbitrary nesting, integer-leaf order, null omission and empty nested arrays; native tagged-tree representation is explicit.
food-chain: Cumulative swallowing order, spider text, first verse, terminal horse verse and multi-verse separation.
forth: Case-insensitive operations, stack order, empty input, underflow/division errors, word overriding and definition-time binding.
game-of-life: Eight neighbors, simultaneous generation, finite board boundaries, survival/birth/death and empty boards.
gigasecond: Exactly one billion seconds, sub-day fields, Gregorian month/leap/year rollover and invalid date-time rejection.
go-counting: Orthogonal connected regions, black/white/mixed/neutral borders, occupied coordinates, invalid coordinates and all territories.
grade-school: Duplicate names across grades, attempted-addition results, alphabetical names within sorted grades and empty queries.
grep: Real input files, multiple filenames, line numbers, case folding, inversion, whole-line matching and filenames-only mode.
hangman: Masked repeated letters, repeated/missing guesses, remaining-guess threshold, win/loss and rejection after game end.
hexadecimal: Manual conversion, both letter cases, leading zeroes, invalid digits and checked fixed-width overflow.
house: All twelve cumulative verses, exact order/text and requested start/end range.
isbn-verifier: Hyphen omission, exactly ten digits, X only in final position and weighted modulus-11 validation.
killer-sudoku-helper: Distinct 1..9 digits, cage size/sum, excluded digits, lexicographic combination order and empty combination.
ledger: Date/order tie-breakers, truncation/alignment, USD/EUR, American/Dutch separators, negative formatting and Unicode character widths.
line-up: Personalized sentence, ordinal 1/2/3 suffixes, 11/12/13 exceptions and valid 1..999 domain.
list-ops: Append/concat/filter/length/map, generic types, ordered left/right folds, reverse and empty lists without delegating list operations.
markdown: Headers 1..6, paragraphs, list open/close transitions, strong/emphasis and multiple inline spans.
matrix: Text parsing, multiple rows/columns, one-based row/column extraction, empty and malformed/ragged inputs.
minesweeper: All eight neighbors, unchanged mines, zero-neighbor spaces, edge/corner/empty boards and malformed cells/rows.
ocr-numbers: All ten glyphs, unknown glyphs, multiple digits/lines, comma separation and 4-row/3-column dimensional checks.
octal: Manual base-eight conversion, leading zeroes and invalid input as zero; checked status API in C/C++.
palindrome-products: Smallest/largest palindrome, every factor pair, equal bounds and invalid/no-product ranges; explicit owned-result API.
point-mutations: Deprecated exercise's zip-to-shorter-strand behavior, differences and empty strands.
poker: All categories including five-of-a-kind across decks, ace-low straight, tie breakers/all tied winners and malformed cards.
pov: Rerooting without input mutation, upward/downward edges, shortest tree path, same/unknown labels and returned-tree ownership.
proverb: Adjacent item links, final first-item line, optional qualifier and empty/single-item input.
pythagorean-triplet: a<b<c, exact requested sum, every valid triple, no triples and 64-bit square intermediates.
rational-numbers: GCD reduction, positive denominator, zero numerator, add/subtract/multiply/divide, absolute value, signed integer powers and real exponentiation.
react: Input/compute cells, multi-input DAG propagation, settled once-only callbacks, unchanged outputs, callback removal and repeated-input ownership.
rectangles: Valid + corners, uninterrupted horizontal/vertical edges, overlapping/shared rectangles and empty/malformed drawings.
relative-distance: Parent/child and sibling edges, shortest undirected connection, shared/two parents, identical people and missing/disconnected-person errors.
resistor-color-expert: One/four/five bands, significant digits, multiplier, all tolerance bands and fractional kilo/mega labels.
resistor-color-trio: First two digits and multiplier through giga, zero and extra bands; integral C/C++ representation preserves exact resistance rather than truncating fractions.
rest-api: Database initialization, sorted/filterable GET, add/IOU POST, opposing debt netting, balances, JSON responses and caller-owned output.
robot-name: AA000 format, retained name, random assignment order, global noncollision, retired-name nonreuse and reset.
saddle-points: Every row-maximum/column-minimum intersection, ties, empty input, checked dimensions and explicit coordinate/result ownership.
satellite: Preorder/inorder reconstruction, child order, empty trees, separate traversal-length validation, unknown/different nodes and duplicate rejection.
scale-generator: Sharp/flat tonic policy, rotated chromatic scale, m/M/A steps, N+1 pitches and actual final note for partial intervals.
sgf-parsing: Sequences/variations, uppercase properties, multiple/duplicate property values, escaping/whitespace rules, malformed input and owned parsed values/identifiers.
simple-cipher: Lowercase nonempty key validation, repeated-key wrap, encode/decode reversibility and random lowercase key generation.
simple-linked-list: Push/pop, head/value/next traversal, length, empty errors, reversed copy and independent list ownership.
square-root: Manual integral square-root algorithm, exact squares, non-square floor behavior and native uint16 input domain.
state-of-tic-tac-toe: X starts, move-count legality, row/column/diagonal wins, incompatible simultaneous wins, ongoing and draw.
strain: Keep/discard predicate complements, ordered results, empty inputs and generic non-integer elements.
swift-scheduling: NOW/ASAP/EOW, month and quarter policies, first/last workdays, leap years and date/time rollover.
tournament: Win/draw/loss inversion, points/played totals, points-then-name sorting, exact columns and ignored malformed lines.
transpose: Rows become columns, uneven lengths, interior padding versus trailing omission, blank rows and empty input.
tree-building: Unordered records, root 0/parent 0, continuous unique IDs, parent-before-child rule and sorted children.
trinary: Manual base-three conversion, leading zeroes, invalid input as zero and native fixed-width integer domain.
twelve-days: All twelve gifts in cumulative reverse order, ordinal day names, first-day versus 'and' punctuation and requested range.
variable-length-quantity: 7-bit groups, high-bit continuation, multiple values, zero/max uint32, incomplete sequences and overflow rejection.
word-search: All eight directions, exact case, zero-based coordinates across native ports, no row wrapping, single characters, empty/absent words and ragged boundaries.
wordy: Signed operands, plus/minus/multiply/divide in left-to-right order, syntax/unsupported operations, zero division and overflow rejection.
zipper: Pure returned navigation/edits, original/focus preservation, independent branches, root/missing-child handling, subtree insertion/removal and safe snapshot lifetime.
